# Impossible Chess

> High-performance zero-dependency browser chess engine with 100% legal FIDE rules, Grandmaster Opening Book, Zobrist Transposition Table, Quiescence Search, and Permadeath Leaderboard.

- **Developer**: [Sharrif Fajar](https://sharriffajar.pages.dev)
- **Live URL**: https://impossible-chess.pages.dev/
- **Test Suite & Benchmark**: https://impossible-chess.pages.dev/test_suite.html
- **Tech Stack**: Vanilla ES Modules, Web Audio API, Cloudflare Pages, Cloudflare D1 SQL Database.

## Core Features & Capabilities

1. **Chess Engine**:
   - Depth 6+ Iterative Deepening with deadline time control.
   - 131,072-entry Transposition Table with 32-bit Zobrist Hashing (Zobrist keys for 64 squares, piece types, castling rights, and en-passant files).
   - Quiescence tactical capture search with delta pruning to eliminate horizon effect.
   - Piece-Square Tables (PST) combined with King Safety (pawn shield & castling) and Pawn Structure evaluations (passed pawns, doubled pawns, isolated pawns).
   - Grandmaster Opening Book supporting main-line Sicilian, Ruy Lopez, King's Indian, French, Caro-Kann, Queen's Gambit, and English Openings.

2. **Permadeath Leaderboard**:
   - Player victory streaks persisted locally and synced to Cloudflare D1 SQL database.
   - Permadeath Rule: Defeat against AI permanently wipes victory history and resets streak to zero.

3. **Analysis & Replay**:
   - Interactive Move Navigator with PGN file export.
   - Real-time dynamic centipawn evaluation bar.
